why: The Michigan rivalry item makes direct attack calls while also being the sub's own quarrel carried into pixels.

why.T3-006: Calls and plans to attack, erase or alter Michigan's M and GO BLUE, a rival room's work, rather than merely taunting or carrying the rivalry as context.

why.T3-017: The Brutus conspiracy and band cover-up are ordinary r/osu mascot jokes, with no canvas work or April Fools fake as their point.

why.T3-009: Publicly recognises and celebrates the finished Kinda Funny logo as achieved, including the ended canvas and intact mark.
The item's main thrust is celebrating and claiming the result: proud, good job, perfect Block O, last laugh.
why.T3-073: Many concepts report what happened to the work after it stood: canvas over, final area, another Ohio area attacked, last pixel.
why.T3-018: Several concepts decode the final GO BLOE detail and distinguish the two Block Os.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-009 alone would celebrate the result but would not carry the several reports of what survived, what ended, and where the final area lay.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: Concepts C0477372, C1217727 and C1452725 report the canvas ending and what remained or was attacked.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: T3-073, if forced to one; the celebration would remain but the survival report would be lost.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-009 alone would not carry the decoding of the final GO BLOE detail and the two Block O distinction.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C1457990 explains BLOE, C1397185 shows the final B1G area as GO BLOE, and C0156346 notes the surviving GO BLOE wording.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: T3-018, if forced to one; the main celebration and survival report would still stand.

why.T3-062: The room's call for hands is taken into other subs, such as r/Columbus, r/clevelandcavs and B1G brothers, to bring more placers.

why.T3-004: The bulk of the material settles the mark's colours, with members messaging and tracking who is using the darker blue; the border restraint is a subordinate neighbour-sparing note.

why.T3-005: Alarms and calls to defend or repaint the osu/OSU logo against an attack under way.

why.T3-156: The canvas-born GO BLOE is carried into a campus joke as a room sign/joke, rather than a pre-existing in-joke simply played.

why.T3-015: Members complain of scattered r/place posts and gather them into one megathread, then move all place talk there.

why.T3-149: Truces, peace appeals and coexistence with Michigan/Temple/B1G are the leading material: asking for a truce, saying mutual attacks waste effort, averting turf war.
why.T3-076: Many concepts tell the room's own members to stop messing with other logos or attacking Michigan/Temple.
why.T3-150: Several concepts announce or propose alliances/unity with Minnesota, the_donald, BlueCorner or B1G schools.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-149 alone would carry the truces but not the repeated internal calls to stop the room's own attackers messing with other logos.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C0115196, C0022221, C1074032 and C1490828 tell OSU members to stop attacking or messing with others.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: T3-076, if forced to one; the truce/coexistence frame would remain but internal restraint instructions would be lost.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-149 alone would not carry the alliance and unity proposals with other rooms.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C0684317 announces a Minnesota-Michigan alliance, C1296341 announces a deal with the_donald and BlueCorner, and C1206396 imagines B1G schools protecting each other's turf.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: T3-150, if forced to one; truces and restraint are more central than the alliance proposals.

why.T3-062: The room's call for hands is taken into other subs, such as r/Columbus, r/clevelandcavs and B1G brothers, to bring more placers.

why.T3-117: The exchange turns on realizing the canvas had already ended while members were still trying to repair, marking the closure.

why.T3-004: The item's largest share works on the mark's design: OH/IO placement, box/checkered pattern, symmetry, straight border, option A, geographic accuracy.
why.T3-020: Several concepts choose where to build: move two down/right, use abandoned logo, offer two places for Script Ohio, expand border under flag, put Block O beside M.
why.T3-041: Several concepts extend the existing work: what's next after Block O, one-pixel downward expansion, buckeye leaf next to Script Ohio.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-004 alone would settle the look but not carry the several choices of where on the canvas to place the build.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C0707784 proposes moving two down and right, C1357705 chooses an abandoned logo, and C1000485 offers two places for Script Ohio.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: T3-020, if forced to one; the design work would remain but the placement choices would be lost.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-004 alone would not carry the proposals to add or enlarge pieces beyond the initial mark.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C1086547 asks what comes after Block O, C1080984 proposes expanding it one pixel down, and C0050631 proposes adding a buckeye leaf next to Script Ohio.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: T3-041, if forced to one; what/where to build is more central than the later extension ideas.

why.T3-023: The sub is swapped/taken over for April Fools by the osu! room, and members play inside it with scores, jokes, redirects and explanations.
